subject.title: [Bug]: Slack reaction_added/reaction_removed events never delivered via Socket Mode (multi-account, v2026.3.24)

question: Should this reaction-specific Slack Socket Mode report remain the canonical live-diagnosis item until current-main multi-account reaction envelopes identify the first drop boundary?
rationale: Source and tests show handler-level support but not the reported live zero-envelope failure, so automation cannot safely choose between Slack delivery, account filtering, authorization, or broader liveness without maintainer/live-workspace proof.

options.title: Keep Reaction-Specific Diagnosis
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical reaction report and require redacted current-main Socket Mode envelopes plus gateway trace logs before a fix PR is queued.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Socket Mode Tracking
options.body: Treat the report as part of the broader Slack Socket Mode delivery cluster only if maintainers decide reaction-specific diagnostics are no longer needed.

recommendation.title: Keep Reaction-Specific Diagnosis
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical reaction report and require redacted current-main Socket Mode envelopes plus gateway trace logs before a fix PR is queued.

likelyOwner.reason: The Slack monitor history points most strongly to steipete for the filtering, reaction authorization, and current handler boundary.
